description: This file defines a Playwright component class for interacting with Ant Design's Select/Combobox UI elements, including methods for opening, selecting options, filtering, and closing dropdowns.

classes.name: Select
classes.description: A Playwright helper class for interacting with Ant Design Select/Combobox components, providing methods to open, select options, filter, and close dropdowns.

methods.name: fromRole
methods.description: Creates a Select instance by locating a combobox role with a given accessible name.

methods.name: element
methods.description: Getter that returns the Locator for the select element.

methods.name: selectOption
methods.description: Opens the dropdown, types to filter, and selects an option by its text.

methods.name: waitForDropdownClose
methods.description: Waits for the dropdown to become hidden after selection.

methods.name: clickOption
methods.description: Clicks an option within an open dropdown by matching its text.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the dropdown by pressing Escape.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Types text into the select's search input to filter options.

methods.name: isVisible
methods.description: Checks if the select element is visible.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the select element is enabled.
